notes.title: Future of BIG LOOT / Roadmap
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]First of all - thank you so much for your reviews, support, and feedback! Every positive review really helps my mental health, boosts Steam’s algorithms to show BIG LOOT to more people, and motivates me to keep working on the game ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]I don’t always have time to answer every question or feedback, but I do my best to read everything. And a huge thanks to those of you who already help by answering others in the community![/p][p][/p][p]I’m already working on the next [b]BIG update (0.3.0)[/b]. A week ago I shared some details in Discord, but here’s a more detailed breakdown:[/p][p][/p][h3]Update 0.3.0 will include:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Different[/b] small towns[/p][/*][*][p]A new type of location - [b]BIG town[/b], where you can buy and restore [b]your own house[/b]. (In future updates, BIG towns will have even more activities.)[/p][/*][*][p]Restoring your house will unlock [b]workbenches[/b] and new features, like [b]repairing caravan modules[/b], [b]crafting without tools[/b], and more[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing changes and item tweaks (for example, some items will finally be stackable 😉)[/p][/*][*][p]New items[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to delete saves[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]📅 Planned release: [b]November 1–15[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Future updates will bring:[/h3][list][*][p]Quality of life improvements (like crafting directly from the caravan)[/p][/*][*][p]New biomes with fresh activities, mechanics, and dangers[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded adventure cards (elite mobs, debuffs, exclusive loot)[/p][/*][*][p]More items and crafting options[/p][/*][*][p]Combat and enemy behaviour improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Trading company expansion (hire caravans, choose your flag, name your company, etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Cooking system[/p][/*][*][p]Goblins and road dangers[/p][/*][*][p]Endgame content and lore items[/p][/*][*][p]Controller & Steam Deck support[/p][/*][*][p]Widescreen support[/p][/*][*][p]Technical improvements (new save system + cloud saving)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]This is just a [b]preview of the roadmap[/b]. Things may change based on feedback, and of course, I don’t want to spoil everything yet.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m still a [b]solo dev[/b] (and still job hunting to pay rent, lol), but my goal is to reach [b]1.0.0 in 1–2 years[/b], maybe even faster. I love survival games, I love BIG LOOT, and I’d love to keep updating it for years, just like the devs of [i]Rust[/i] or [i]Don’t Starve[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Early Access is live! 0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]After almost 2 years in development, I’ve finally launched early access to my first PC game. I can’t believe my dream game is becoming real! Unfortunately, it happened a little earlier than planned because of my job situation, which I described in [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3116730/announcements/detail/501701175839558028"]the previous post[/url]. Anyway, I want to say a BIG thank you to everyone who played the demo, sent feedback, and supported me with kind words, it means the world to me! I love you guys! [b]❤️[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As far as I know, Steam’s algorithms like games that have good activity at launch. So if you can buy the game, play it, and write a review as soon as possible, I’ll be extremely grateful. It can really make a difference. As a solo dev, I can rely only on you![/p][p][/p][p]For the past few months, I’ve been working really hard on new content and fixes. The demo was played by about 5500 players, and you submitted over 600 feedback forms - that’s a BIG number for a small dev like me. I carefully read all of them, fixed a lot of things, and made notes for future updates. Thank you for your time! Below, you’ll find the patch notes.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]0.2.0 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]New features and content:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Level and Perks System[/b][/p][p]You’ll gain XP for all kinds of activities - exploring the world, gathering resources, defeating enemies, and more. Every time you level up, you’ll get a skill point to spend. For now, there are 50 levels, 5 skill branches (Hunger, Thirst, Stamina, Strength, Protection), and 25 perks, including some legendary ones with awesome buffs![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Trading Company[/b][/p][p]Take big trade orders for gold coins, improve your company, and unlock more order slots! You can also buy road passes here for new biomes. In the future, the Trading Company will get more mechanics, like hiring teams for separate adventures, choosing your flag, company name, and more.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Items Book[/b][/p][p]I like collections in games, and I know that some of you have been waiting for this feature as well. In the menu, you can now see your full collection of items and track how many you’ve unlocked.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Biome - Golden Sands[/b][/p][p]This biome is really different from the forest ones. It’s a desert with a new plant - the Green Cactus. Take your axe and see what you can gather from it. This biome is also a great source for farming ores, as it has twice as many as forests, and silver can now only be found here. You’ll also discover a brand new point of interest, ruins, and new enemies! The biome is available from adventure level 4 and up.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Items and Crafts[/b][/p][p]The game now has 107 items and about 60 crafting recipes, and this list is constantly growing. One of the new items is the [b]Caravan Compass[/b] - an item that shows you the direction and distance to your caravan.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Enemies[/b][/p][p]Added spiders, as well as new types of wolves and boars for higher danger levels. Spiders are a source of silk for crafting silk threads, which are needed for new high-tier armor. In future updates, I plan to rework the behavior of all enemies, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Elite Enemies[/b][/p][p]A new type of enemy marked with a red skull. They spawn rarely, have more health and damage, and drop exclusive, valuable loot. In this patch, meet the [b]Brown Bear[/b] - it drops components for [b]epic high-tier armor[/b]. Found only in Windy Hills and Orange Forest, and in adventures with danger level 4 and above. Happy hunting![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlocked new adventure levels[/b][/p][p]Now 6 out of 10 levels are available. Levels 5–6 require a new [b]Purple Seal Scroll[/b], which can be bought at the Trading Company.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Orange Forest[/b] is now even more… Orange ;D[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Rebalanced Loot and Points of Interest[/b][/p][p]Each biome now has unique advantages - different amounts of ores, plants, exclusive loot, and more.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements and fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved jumping[/p][/*][*][p]Improved adventure generation: now no more than 2 similar biomes can be offered at once, with different settings (loot rating, danger level)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved loot spawning: more chances to find items on surfaces, and up to 4 items can spawn in one stack[/p][/*][*][p]Shortened and sped up the pickaxe swing animation[/p][/*][*][p]Time flow can now be changed while sitting on the cart (x1, x3, x5)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed small rocks on roads (they confused new players who tried to gather them)[/p][/*][*][p]Character now always dismounts the cart correctly, without being pushed forward[/p][/*][*][p]Cart sounds stop when the game is paused[/p][/*][*][p]Added FPS limit option to the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug with hills on roads[/p][/*][*][p]UI improvements and performance optimizations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There are a lot of plans for new content and improvements that I’m extremely excited to implement, because I’ve always dreamed about a survival game like this one. In future updates, you can expect new BIG cities with different activities - for example, a broken house you can buy, restore, and unlock new features in. There will also be new biomes, new enemy behavior, new weapons, and more! [/p][p]Check out the roadmap and chat with the community on Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/cumGeJcPz8"]https://discord.gg/cumGeJcPz8[/url][/p]

notes.title: Exclusive Reward for Demo Players
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!
The release is getting closer, and I want to thank once again everyone who played the demo, sent feedback, and reported bugs. That means the world to me!
[/p][p]On [b]August 21[/b], the demo will be closed, and I’ll be releasing the [b]Early Access of BIG LOOT[/b]. Can’t believe it’s really happening…
[/p][p]Steam’s algorithms love games with strong launch activity. So if you can buy the game, play it, and leave a review as soon as possible, I’ll be extremely grateful!
[/p][p]As a special thank you:

[b]Everyone who played the demo[/b] [b]and buys the game within the first 7 days[/b] (with a [b]20% [/b]launch discount) will receive an [b]exclusive reward[/b] -✨ [b]Golden Shorts for Blackbeard [/b]✨[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128087/512178477a29fd5faa427c43bed80df394563184.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you haven’t joined yet, I’d love to see you in our cozy [url="https://discord.gg/cumGeJcPz8"]Discord community[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]The last couple of months have been really intense, but your support helped me get through it. Seriously, thank you![/p][p]Almost 4.000 players tried the demo, and over 500 of you sent feedback via Google Forms, Discord, or Steam. That's incredible! I've already fixed some things and continue working hard on new content for Early Access.[/p][p]The full patch notes will be published on [b]August 21st[/b] - and yes, that’s also the [b]Early Access release date[/b]! 🎉[/p][p]I’ll share more details on that day. Thanks again for playing and for all your support, it truly means a lot to me![/p]

notes.title: Bad News… but the Release Is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p]The game market is tough and I just got some bad news: I’ve been laid off. I don’t know how long it will take to find a new job, so I want to use this time to focus on making my dream come true. Over the next two months, I’ll be working hard on BIG LOOT to deliver as much content as possible for Early Access.[/p][p]I already know what hard work feels like - for months I’ve been working 12 hours a day (8 hours at my main job and 4 hours on BIG LOOT). Now I’ll have even more time for the game! 😄[/p][p]I originally planned to release my game in Early Access later this year (around Q4), but things have changed a bit. Now, I’m aiming to launch [b]Early Access in August[/b]!
[/p][p]Here’s what you can expect in Early Access compared to the demo:[/p][list][*][p]A full perk system[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to manage your own trade company (accepting trade orders, buying items to unlock new locations)[/p][/*][*][p]New ways to stay hydrated (I know a lot of you were waiting for this one 😄)[/p][/*][*][p]New items, plants, biomes, enemies (both common and elite), adventure levels, and more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, I know that BIG LOOT won’t give me the kind of long-term freedom that massive games like Rust or Stardew Valley gave their creators. Survival games are especially tough to make - even more so for a solo dev. But I couldn’t choose any other genre. I love this one. BIG LOOT is my dream project.[/p][p]I truly believe that a small community can make a BIG difference. I hope that launching Early Access in August and selling some copies will give me at least 2-3 months of extra time before I find a new job. I’m a BIG dreamer… but sadly, dreams don’t pay for rent or food 😅
[/p][p]BIG thanks to everyone who tested the game during the playtests, played the demo, wishlisted, or even told friends about BIG LOOT. It means the world to me! I’ll keep working on my dream - no matter what![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo is Live Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After 1.5 years of late-night work after my day job, I finally have something playable to share with you. The free demo is now live on Steam — and I’d love to hear what you think!

Huge thanks to all the playtesters — your feedback was incredibly helpful, and I truly appreciate your support.

💬 Feel free to join our community on Discord to share your thoughts, report bugs, or just hang out:
